instructions:
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。未核验事实继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
official 要求已打开一手来源；multi_source_verified 要求两家独立可靠来源，A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。未确认内容仅进 rumors，tracking=true，标题摘要保留不确定性。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。
默认尝试完整 locales.en：在相同 include/sharedFactFrame 内独立写自然英文，优先英文一手证据正式专名；只有中文证据也不得扩充事实。entries 按 include 顺序以 eventKey 对应，upcoming 仅按 upcomingId 对应本次 patch，继承项不重复。headline/summary/verification/timeNote 必须完整英文，无中文 fallback；sourceReport 完整英文或 null，其余显示字段按需提供英文。
如果无法在事实边界内可靠完成完整英文稿，可以省略 locales.en；publisher 标记 unavailable，不能削弱中文 Canonical 来迁就英文。不要填写 factsDigest/canonicalCopyDigest/localeDigest 或猜最终 entryId，均由 trusted publisher 生成绑定。
archiveTitle 对应 period：日报｜、早报｜、晚报｜；英文对应 Daily Brief |、Morning Brief |、Evening Brief |。Daily 窗口为前日10:10 exclusive 至当日10:10 inclusive，plannedAt=当日12:00；10:10—12:00 新事实属于下一期，历史迁移窗口以 packet 为准。
早报 upcomingMode=replace 重建未来15天；晚报 inherit_and_patch。日报必须使用 upcomingMode=inherit_and_patch，不复制 upcomingBaseline.items；不要因为本次 packet 没有新的发售证据而提交空表覆盖历史。trusted publisher 继承 Canonical 基线并剔除当日及15天窗口外项。仅提交新增/变更 upcoming 或有证据支持延期取消的 removeUpcomingIds，必须有 HTTPS 来源。
upcomingBaseline.refreshRange 是 packet-only 的唯一日历例外：每天核验完整 startInclusive—endInclusive，不把旧期次当作已完成核验。打开开发商/发行商公告或 PlayStation/Nintendo/Xbox/Steam 官方页面；新查事实仅用于日历，不得改变新闻 packages/trackingQueue 决定、正文、时间、factStatus、来源分类或 tracking。无可靠来源不填充，不因发现失败删除条目。
upcomingDiscovery 仅是线索。优先 knownTitle、crossSource、inBaseline=false；采用前打开官方详情，核对完整游戏身份、日期、平台、地区和正式版/抢先体验/移植/DLC。日期冲突不可猜选，reviewLinks 是待阅读文章而非游戏项。对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 分别检查完整15天；coverage 为 failed/empty_or_changed、列表不全或 omittedCandidates>0 时针对补查，并在 sourceReport 记录实际检查和缺口，不得声称全量覆盖。

sources.label: Gematsu

Survival climbing adventure game Cairn’s free downloadable content “On the Trail: Deep Water” will launch on October 29, developer The Game Bakers announced.
Cairn free DLC ‘On the Trail: Deep Water’ launches October 29
Survival climbing adventure game Cairn ‘s free downloadable content “On the Trail: Deep Water” will launch on October 29, developer The Game Bakers announced.
“On the Trail: Deep Water” is the first of a series of free downloadable content bringing Cairn climbers with new climbing locations and fresh challenges as they follow the trail of a legendary climber. The downloadable content brings three new climbing areas, and introduces water soloing: players can now climb over water, without the consequences of plummeting to their death! Marco won’t be cheering from the sideline anymore, players can now climb with him or Aava.
Cairn is available now for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam , Epic Games Store , and GOG . A Switch 2 version is due out in early 2027.

Dream Club Zero R+ announced for console
D3 Publisher has announced Dream Club Zero R+ , a new port of the romance simulation game Dream Club Zero for console. It will launch in 2027 in Japan. Release platforms were not announced.
Dream Club Zero first launched for Xbox 360 on January 27, 2011 in Japan, followed by PS Vita as Dream Club Zero Portable on November 17, 2011, and PlayStation 3 as Dream Club Zero Special Edipyon! on January 17, 2013.
The new port will feature three new host girls designed by Haruyuki Morisawa, who handled character designs for previous Dream Club games.
Further information will be announced at a later date.

packages.headline: Honkai: Star Rail version 4.6 update ‘Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise’ launches September 28

sources.label: Gematsu
sources.evidenceText:
The version 4.6 update for Honkai: Star Rail, dubbed “Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise,” will launch on September 28, developer miHoYo announced.
Honkai: Star Rail version 4.6 update ‘Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise’ launches September 28
The version 4.6 update for Honkai: Star Rail , dubbed “Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise,” will launch on September 28, developer miHoYo announced.
Following the conclusion of the previous story, Nihilux officially revealed her identity as Aha, the Aeon of Elation. Now, alongside the Trailblazer and with Pearl’s assistance, they will head to the Life Sciences Institute deep within Astropolis to uncover the truth behind the scheme to “weaponize the husk.”
Serving as the source of all imagenae in Astropolis, the Life Sciences Institute was built under the leadership of Madam Yabuli, head of the IPC’s Technology Department. Now, Yabuli is pushing forward a dangerous plan to “weaponize the husk,” at the cost of every life in Planarcadia, and is even suspected of harboring ties with a mysterious faction that worships the Voracity in Astropolis. To protect the peace of Planarcadia, Pearl plans to use the recovery of Leviathan Essence as a cover to dispatch Kuchiba and Ashveil on a coordinated investigation deep into the Life Sciences Institute, teaming up with the Trailblazer and Nihilux to crush this conspiracy once and for all.
In this update, Pearl, a 5-star Ice character following the Path of Elation, will officially become a playable character. The CEO of Planarcadia has always been known for her raw computational power and rational decision-making. When the critical threat of the Voracity struck, she decisively arranged for Planarcadia’s residents to evacuate on the Astral Express, while she herself stayed behind to oversee the encanvasing ritual. In this story, Pearl and the Trailblazer will witness together how “Preservation” and “Art” ultimately merge into a single theme. Outside the story, Pearl’s understanding of art is equally reflected in combat. During combat, Pearl can consume her “Certified Banger” to offset a portion of DMG for all ally characters. At the same time, Pearl can enter the “Deep Learning” state to learn the combat data of a designated teammate and gain a corresponding Enhanced ATK. If this teammate is an Elation character, Pearl’s Enhanced ATK will deal additional Elation DMG to enemies. If the entire team consists of Elation characters, this teammate will also gain an extra turn, while receiving a massive amount of Punchline and “Certified Banger.”
Throughout Version 4.6, the drop rates for the limited 5-star character Pearl and the limited 5-star Light Cone “Colors for Tomorrow” will both be boosted. The limited 5-star character Evanescia will also receive a rerun in the first half of the version. Then, in the second half, the limited 5-star character Mortenax Blade will be getting a rerun, continuing to provide indispensable help for your trailblazing expedition.
As for the version’s events, the brand-new “Love, Ghosts & Robots” event is coming soon. The Trailblazer will help the resurrected Skott run a mechatron workshop, assembling and selling mechatrons to gradually build the workshop into a project with a five-star rating. Meanwhile, the massive combat reality show event, “Interastral Peace Gala: One Take,” will also kick off. On top of that, the brand-new “Astral Imagea” gameplay will officially debut. Trailblazers can obtain multiple Astral Imageas to tag along on their adventures, and co-op with friends to take on the “Astral Slammers Squad!” challenge. Furthermore, Hyacine’s new outfit “Warm Cotton Skies” and Evanescia’s new outfit “Lunar Blossoming” will hit the Outfit Show Window together. Yo

packages.headline: Industrial noir occult turn-based RPG WANE announced for PC

sources.label: Gematsu
sources.evidenceText:
Publisher Shoreline Games and developer Metis Creative have announced WANE, an industrial noir occult turn-based RPG. It will be available for PC via Steam. A release date was not announced.
Industrial noir occult turn-based RPG WANE announced for PC
Publisher Shoreline Games and developer Metis Creative have announced WANE , an industrial noir occult turn-based RPG. It will be available for PC via Steam . A release date was not announced.
“Metis Creative has the kind of imagination that makes you want to pay attention to whatever they’re working on next,” said Shoreline Games CEO Keith Kawamura in a press release. “Having already had the chance to work with the team once before, we knew firsthand just how thoughtful and inventive they are. WANE is a fantastic example of that creativity, and from the moment we saw what the team was creating, we knew we wanted to help bring it to players. We’re thrilled to be partnering with Metis again and finally begin sharing WANE with the world.”
Metis Creative CEO Sarp Duyar added, “Metis Creative has found success in our ability to produce high-quality, original visuals that match a deep and engaging narrative across several award-winning tabletop games. Our vision with WANE is to continue that tradition across a totally new medium for us and push the boundaries of our creativity.”
In WANE , players take on the role of Declan Wayne, a fading archaeologist whose fractured memories have transformed his cerebral realm of Ravelle into a shifting labyrinth of trauma, obsession, and regret. Players recruit adventurers, build a three-person party, and descend through three distinct biomes in grid-based tactical combat shaped by attrition, random encounters, and boss battles.
Between expeditions, players return to an antiquarian shop to appraise and sell relics, upgrade facilities, and fund the next run. As the roguelike cycle continues, new synergies, shortcuts, and permanent buffs open up while the story unfolds through repeated journeys deeper into Ravelle.

sources.label: Gematsu
sources.evidenceText:
Mac n Cheese Games has announced Dust till Dawn, a cozy paranormal cleaning game set in a rural Japanese village. It will be available for PC via Steam. A release date was not announced.
Junji Ito-inspired cozy paranormal cleaning game Dust till Dawn announced for PC
Mac n Cheese Games has announced Dust till Dawn , a cozy paranormal cleaning game set in a rural Japanese village. It will be available for PC via Steam . A release date was not announced.
Here is an overview of the game, via Mac n Cheese Games:
Dust till Dawn is a cozy paranormal cleaning game set in a fictional rural Japanese village where a mysterious dust has begun appearing across homes, businesses, and community spaces.
Dust till Dawn combines the meditative satisfaction of cleaning games with the creeping unease and surreal imagery of Japanese horror manga.
Players step into the role of a maid taking cleaning jobs throughout the village. Sweep, wipe, wash, and carefully restore each location, bringing calm and order back one space at a time.
Settle into the satisfying rhythm of putting things back in order. Sweep away dust, wipe surfaces, clean rooms, and restore everything from family homes and shops to public buildings and other corners of the village.
The dust shouldn’t be here. Neither should the objects that seem to move, the rooms that refuse to stay in order, or the traces of something passing through after you’ve finished cleaning.

packages.headline: 这款动作射击游戏逆龄增长？腾讯收购后月均用户数创纪录，最高+50%，怎么做到的？

sources.label: 36氪游戏圈大事件
sources.evidenceText:
拆解《Warframe》长青逆增长的运营策略
这款动作射击游戏逆龄增长？腾讯收购后月均用户数创纪录，最高+50%，怎么做到的？
一款已经积累8500万+全球用户的游戏，如今仍在突破用户规模上限。但深挖这个长线运营的成功案例，了解其“背景故事”后会发现，《Warframe》（星际战甲）最值得研究的地方还不仅仅如此。
2025年，腾讯国际市场收入首次突破100亿美元，同比增长33%——在全年业绩演示中，腾讯首次点名Digital Extremes旗下《Warframe》，将其近年的在线表现与国际游戏业务增长联系起来。
在2026年第二季度的业绩演示上，《Warframe》再次被点名，其中提到其总流水和平均日活跃用户都创下了历史新高。
作为腾讯海外重要的长青标杆，《Warframe》至今依然保持着持续增长的用户规模与活跃的产品生态，甚至成为大盘业务增长的新变量。 这种“逆龄”表现的背后，似乎有着与大部分F2P游戏不一样的运营逻辑和成长路径。

『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』は、主人公の二面性をフックとしただけの作品ではなく、「本当の自分とは何なのか」という題材からキャラクターを丁寧に描いている作品だ。
「乙女ゲーム脳の主人公」の学園ラブコメ、『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』を今こそ遊んでみよう。題材はキャッチーだが描写は丁寧で深みもある
連載第9回となる本稿では、サークル「TetraScope」が手がける乙女ゲーム『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』を紹介。もとは2014年にフリー同人ゲームとしてリリースされた作品で、2022年にはフルボイス化&ヴィジュアルファンブックの内容を追加したSteam版やスマートフォン版が展開。2024年にはNintendo Switch向けに移植されるなど、長きに渡り愛されてきたタイトルだ。
また本作における「本当の自分」というテーマは、恋愛だけに限定されたものではない。希美は周囲から見れば充実した高校生活を送り、友人にも恵まれ、学校では頼られる存在として振る舞っているが、「何も悩みもないリア充」として描かれているわけではない。むしろ周囲から見れば恵まれているからこそ、自分の悩みを人に話すことが難しくなるという感覚が、彼女の人物像にリアリティを与えている。そういった意味では、「私のリアルは充実しすぎている」というタイトルも、単に主人公がモテモテだから自虐で付けられたタイトルではないのだろう。
『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』は、乙女ゲームを遊ぶ主人公をプレイヤーが操作するという構造を入口にしながら、他人から見える自分と自分だけが知っている自分の違い、好きなものを好きでいることを軽快なラブコメディのなかに落とし込んでいる。「自分が周囲からどう見られているのか」「本当の自分とは何なのか」という身近な題材からキャラクターを掘り下げながら、乙女ゲームというジャンルへの愛も感じる作品だ。
『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』は、PC（ Steam / Windows ）/ Nintendo Switch / iOS / Android 向けに配信中。
Steamでは日々数多くのゲームがリリースされている一方で、個人や少人数チームによる国産タイトルには大作の話題に隠れながらも、独創的なアイデアや強いこだわりを持つ作品が少なくない。本連載「見逃してない？ 国産Steamタイトル発掘録」では、同人・インディーゲームを中心に、国産Steamタイトルを毎回1本ずつピックアップして魅力を伝えていきたい。
公式では「顔良し、頭良し、性格良し。完全無欠のリア充女子が送るドタバタラブコメディ！（たぶん）」とされており、物語の主人公は高校2年生の姉崎希美。キャッチコピーどおり容姿端麗・成績も優秀で、性格も申し分なく、学校では生徒会副会長を務めるという、まさに周囲から見れば「完璧な人間」だ。だが彼女には誰にも知られていない一面があり、希美は乙女ゲームが大好きなオタクとして、学校で見せている姿からは想像しにくい趣味を持っている。

packages.headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Will 'Easily Take Over 100 Hours' for Completionists to Beat, Director Teases

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi teased that completionist playthroughs for the remake trilogy's conclusion could "easily take over a hundred hours" to beat.
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Will 'Easily Take Over 100 Hours' for Completionists to Beat, Director Teases
The developer helping lead the charge on Cloud and the rest of the party's final assault against Sephiroth opened up about the size of the final chapter during an interview with GameSpot . We already suspected there would be a lot to do when Final Fantasy 7 Revelation launches for PC and consoles next year, but it sounds like those looking to see all Square Enix has to offer will be especially busy.
"In a standard playthrough from beginning to end, if I were to review and check every single asset and element in the game, it’ll easily take over a hundred hours," Hamaguchi said of his own playthroughs. "Obviously, I can't do that in each and every single playthrough. As the director, I don’t have enough time for that, so sometimes I would just skip combat and focus on checking the main story."
That's a lot of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation playtime. The two previous entries in the trilogy – Remake and Rebirth – proved to be large games in their own right, but the 2027 RPG finale will no doubt up the ante yet again . As Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Vincent Valentine, and the rest of the crew try to finish the fight against Sephiroth, players will use a giant airship known as the Highwind to travel.
"I will try to do these playthroughs as much time as time allows," he said. "Yesterday, during a separate round of interviews, when there was downtime, I actually did bring a PS5 controller, so I checked the latest version of the build. Even on business trips, if there’s even a small amount of time that I have available, I’ll try to check the latest version of the game to see if there are any issues."
It's important to remember that not everyone will sink the same amount of time into Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. Some will no doubt turn over every pixel on the planet, while others will surely beeline their way through the story.
How long some of these different playthroughs will take is unclear, and with months to go until launch, Hamaguchi's 100-hour estimate could always change. Either way, the team is anticipating a hefty download, with the director recently telling VGC that the game could eat around 200GB of storage .
Naoki Hamaguchi says he's already reached the credits 46 times.

packages.headline: Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Hideo Kojima reveals what happened with Sony in his first interview since PlayStation ditched Physint.
Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint
In June, Sony asked Hideo Kojima to attend a Zoom call. At the time, he was busy working on Xbox game OD and PlayStation game Physint , the latter a spiritual successor to the video game series that made him one of the most celebrated developers on the planet: Metal Gear Solid.
For the meeting, he brought along Kojima Productions president Shinji Hirano and head of talent development Aki Saito. Kojima tells IGN in his first interview since last week’s dramatic news that he was so stunned by what Sony told him that his mind went blank. PlayStation was pulling out of the Physint project, and funding for it would end. And that was that.
Kojima initially kept the news from his staff at Kojima Productions as he worried over the future of his company. Would he have to let developers from the Physint team go? Would they leave anyway, given what had happened? What would the bank, whose loans helped Kojima Productions staff up after the release of Death Stranding, think? And what about all the actors he’d already scanned for Physint? Was this a P.T. situation all over again?
As we know, Kojima convinced Microsoft and new Xbox boss Asha Sharma to pick up Physint in one of the most dramatic console switches in history. Now the previous PlayStation exclusive may not release on PlayStation at all.
In our interview, Kojima tells IGN Japan’s Daniel Robson how he feared Kojima Productions might collapse as a result of Sony's decision, and details his game-saving pitch to Xbox, which was quick to snap Physint up.
It’s important to note that the interview was conducted before Bloomberg’s report that Sony ditched Physint due to missed deadlines, budget concerns, and Death Stranding’s alleged commercial failings . Kojima Productions provided a statement to IGN, which appears at the end of this interview, following a request for comment. In it, Kojima Productions insists the studio is "in a healthy, profitable state, development for Physint continues to move forward with Xbox, and our relationship with PlayStation remains strong.​"
Hideo Kojima: We are an independent company, so no funding is behind us as a corporation. We sign contracts according to projects, and that's how we survive one by one as an indie. So I need to find a new project before the previous project ends, and that's how we stay alive. That's our background situation.
"I didn't want to do the same thing we did for P.T."
